sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市的DealBook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最有影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk,
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、

sentences.en: Christine Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、扎伊尔兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话实况。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在nytimes.com上直播部分采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: The state of vaccinations.
sentences.zh: 疫苗接种现状。

sentences.en: My colleague, Aporvo Mondavili, on the rapid expansion of inoculations.
sentences.zh: 我的同事阿普尔瓦·曼达维利将介绍疫苗接种的快速推广情况。

sentences.en: Who is still holding out?
sentences.zh: 还有谁在观望？

sentences.en: And the new rules of the road for those who are now vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 以及为已接种疫苗者制定的新行为准则。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, March 25th.
sentences.zh: 今天是3月25日，星期四。

sentences.en: Aporva, good evening.
sentences.zh: 阿普尔瓦，晚上好。

sentences.en: Hi, Michael.
sentences.zh: 你好，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Nice to talk to you again.
sentences.zh: 很高兴再次与你交谈。

sentences.en: Nice to talk to you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴与你交谈。

sentences.en: It feels, Aporva, like after many months of frustrating sluggishness, that the story of vaccinations in the United States is now moving so quickly that it's actually
sentences.zh: 阿普尔瓦，感觉在经历了数月令人沮丧的缓慢进展后，美国的疫苗接种故事现在发展得如此之快，以至于

sentences.en: kind of hard to keep track of.
sentences.zh: 让人有点跟不上节奏了。

sentences.en: And so that's why we wanted to check in with you about where exactly everything stands with inoculations.
sentences.zh: 所以我们想和你核实一下疫苗接种的最新进展。

sentences.en: And I want to start with a question that I think has loomed over this entire process, which is when the general population, adults,
sentences.zh: 我想从一个我认为一直笼罩在整个过程中的问题开始，那就是普通人群，即成年人，

sentences.en: no matter how old or with what medical conditions, when they will be allowed to book appointments to get their shot.
sentences.zh: 无论年龄大小或身体状况如何，何时才能获准预约接种疫苗。

sentences.en: And Biden said May 1st, but my sense is that it's actually starting to happen a little bit faster.
sentences.zh: 拜登说是5月1日，但我的感觉是，实际上开始得比这要快一些。

sentences.en: So I wonder if you can walk us through that.
sentences.zh: 所以我想请你为我们梳理一下。

sentences.en: I think part of the reason it's been tough to keep up is because every state is moving at a different pace.
sentences.zh: 我认为难以跟上节奏的部分原因是每个州推进的速度都不一样。

sentences.en: And almost every other day, there's a new announcement about which state is opening vaccinations up to all adults.
sentences.zh: 几乎每隔一天，就会有关于哪个州向所有成年人开放疫苗接种的新公告。

sentences.en: So if you live in Alaska or Mississippi or West
sentences.zh: 所以如果你住在阿拉斯加、密西西比或西

sentences.en: Virginia, you're lucky enough to already get a vaccine.
sentences.zh: 弗吉尼亚州，你很幸运，已经可以接种疫苗了。

sentences.en: If you live in Connecticut, you can start to get one April 5th.
sentences.zh: 如果你住在康涅狄格州，4月5日就可以开始接种。

sentences.en: If you're in Georgia, you can start this week.
sentences.zh: 如果你在佐治亚州，本周就可以开始。

sentences.en: In Texas, you can get it on Monday.
sentences.zh: 在德克萨斯州，周一就可以接种。

sentences.en: If you live in Indiana, you can get it next week.
sentences.zh: 如果你住在印第安纳州，下周就可以接种。

sentences.en: And New York State, where I live, just announced that they would give the vaccine to anyone 50 and over.
sentences.zh: 而我居住的纽约州刚刚宣布，将为所有50岁及以上的人提供疫苗。

sentences.en: Doesn't cover me, but I'm hoping that that means pretty soon they'll start to move down the lane.
sentences.zh: 虽然还没轮到我，但我希望这意味着他们很快就会降低年龄门槛。

sentences.en: So you can see that it's sort of every state is getting there at a different pace.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以看到，每个州达到这一目标的进度各不相同。

sentences.en: But I think
sentences.zh: 但我认为

sentences.en: Biden's announcement that every adult who wants one will get it by May 1st is pretty realistic.
sentences.zh: 拜登宣布所有想要接种的成年人都能在5月1日前接种，这是相当现实的。

sentences.en: And as you said, we may even get there sooner.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，我们甚至可能更快达到这一目标。

sentences.en: Mm hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: What's your understanding of why things are now moving so much faster when it comes to vaccines?
sentences.zh: 你认为为什么疫苗接种现在进展得如此之快？

sentences.en: Is this simply a question of how long it took to ramp up the supply?
sentences.zh: 这仅仅是因为提高供应量花了很长时间吗？

sentences.en: Is this about us just getting better at administering them and finding people to administer them?
sentences.zh: 还是因为我们在管理和寻找接种人员方面做得更好了？

sentences.en: Supply was never the issue.
sentences.zh: 供应从来都不是问题。

sentences.en: We had plenty of doses sitting around.
sentences.zh: 我们有大量的剂量闲置。

sentences.en: I think what the issue was was that we were just not getting the doses out to the people who needed them fast enough.
sentences.zh: 我认为问题在于我们没有足够快地将这些剂量送到需要的人手中。

sentences.en: And we've solved a lot of those distribution problems now, which, you know, when you think about it is pretty understandable.
sentences.zh: 现在我们已经解决了许多分发问题，考虑到这一点，这其实是可以理解的。

sentences.en: We've never done a mass vaccination campaign of this scale this quickly.
sentences.zh: 我们从未如此迅速地进行过这种规模的大规模疫苗接种运动。

sentences.en: And it took a little while to figure out all the glitches.
sentences.zh: 花了一些时间才找出所有的小故障。

sentences.en: And I think the Biden administration has solved some of them.
sentences.zh: 我认为拜登政府已经解决了一些问题。

sentences.en: We now have mobile vaccination sites.
sentences.zh: 我们现在有了移动疫苗接种点。

sentences.en: We have 24-hour sites.
sentences.zh: 我们有24小时接种点。

sentences.en: Pharmacies are giving them out.
sentences.zh: 药店也在提供接种。

sentences.en: We've got three different vaccines that have three different sorts of storage.
sentences.zh: 我们有三种不同的疫苗，需要三种不同的储存方式。

sentences.en: So we've just really corrected all the problems that we had initially, and we're now moving at a pretty good clip.
sentences.zh: 所以我们确实纠正了最初的所有问题，现在正以相当快的速度推进。

sentences.en: Gotcha.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: And everything you just said is predicated on the current scenario of those three vaccines, Pfizer, Johnson & Johnson,
sentences.zh: 你刚才所说的一切都是基于目前这三种疫苗——辉瑞、强生、

sentences.en: Moderna, all of which have been authorized for emergency use in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 莫德纳——的情况，它们都已在美国获得紧急使用授权。

sentences.en: My sense is that a fourth vaccine could soon be in the mix in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我的感觉是，第四种疫苗可能很快也会加入美国的行列。

sentences.en: And I wonder if that's a correct assumption.
sentences.zh: 我想知道这个假设是否正确。

sentences.en: And if it is, would that change the speed of this rollout that we've been describing?
sentences.zh: 如果是的话，这会改变我们所描述的推广速度吗？

sentences.en: And here, of course, I'm talking about AstraZeneca, about which there has been a fair bit of drama.
sentences.zh: 当然，我指的是阿斯利康疫苗，围绕它已经发生了很多戏剧性的事情。

sentences.en: So the AstraZeneca situation is a bit confusing.
sentences.zh: 阿斯利康的情况确实有点令人困惑。

sentences.en: Earlier this week, AstraZeneca came out with a study that showed that it's a very safe and effective vaccine.
sentences.zh: 本周早些时候，阿斯利康发布了一项研究，显示这是一种非常安全有效的疫苗。

sentences.en: But then the National Institutes of Health and the Data Safety Monitoring Board, which is this group that looks at all the data
sentences.zh: 但随后，美国国立卫生研究院和数据安全监测委员会——这个负责审查临床试验所有数据的组织——

sentences.en: from the clinical trial, came out with a pretty strong statement saying that they didn't agree
sentences.zh: 发表了一份措辞强硬的声明，表示不同意

sentences.en: with how AstraZeneca had presented its data and said maybe some of that data was now outdated.
sentences.zh: 阿斯利康展示其数据的方式，并称其中一些数据可能已经过时。

sentences.en: So we don't know exactly how good AstraZeneca is.
sentences.zh: 所以我们不确定阿斯利康疫苗到底有多好。

sentences.en: It looks like it's pretty good.
sentences.zh: 看起来相当不错。

sentences.en: We just don't know how good.
sentences.zh: 只是我们不知道具体有多好。

sentences.en: But none of that may really matter for the United States because by the time AstraZeneca
sentences.zh: 但这对美国来说可能并不重要，因为等到阿斯利康

sentences.en: would be authorized here, we would probably be done vaccinating all the adults who want a vaccine.
sentences.zh: 在这里获得授权时，我们可能已经完成了所有想要接种疫苗的成年人的接种工作。

sentences.en: Between Pfizer and Moderna and J&J, we will probably have more than enough doses.
sentences.zh: 在辉瑞、莫德纳和强生之间，我们可能已经有了绰绰有余的剂量。

sentences.en: And we may actually end up giving away all the AstraZeneca doses that we do have.
sentences.zh: 我们甚至可能最终会捐赠掉我们拥有的所有阿斯利康疫苗。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 哈。

sentences.en: God, that would be a far cry from where we all were a year ago.
sentences.zh: 天哪，这与我们一年前的情况大相径庭。

sentences.en: The concept that we wouldn't need a vaccine approved by the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我们竟然不需要一种获得美国政府批准的疫苗，

sentences.en: government.
sentences.zh: 这个概念。

sentences.en: But that is, I guess, where we are.
sentences.zh: 但我想这就是我们现在的处境。

sentences.en: I think that is something that maybe people don't marvel at enough.
sentences.zh: 我认为这或许是人们还没有足够惊叹的事情。

sentences.en: The idea that we did not even dream that we could have a vaccine this quickly.
sentences.zh: 我们甚至从未梦想过能如此迅速地获得疫苗。

sentences.en: And here we are vaccinating millions of people every day.
sentences.zh: 而现在我们每天都在为数百万人接种疫苗。

sentences.en: And we have three good candidates and a fourth one in the offing.
sentences.zh: 我们有三种优秀的候选疫苗，第四种也即将问世。

sentences.en: That's just amazing.
sentences.zh: 这真是太神奇了。

sentences.en: Well said.
sentences.zh: 说得好。

sentences.en: So during this period we're in, in which some adults are still waiting to become eligible
sentences.zh: 那么在我们所处的这个时期，一些成年人仍在等待获得所在州的接种资格，

sentences.en: in their states, I'm sure you're aware of this, there seem to be a lot of adults who are trying to work the angles to get a vaccine before they are technically eligible.
sentences.zh: 我相信你已经注意到了，似乎有很多成年人试图想方设法在正式获得资格之前接种疫苗。

sentences.en: And my question for you is, is that okay?
sentences.zh: 我想问你的是，这样做可以吗？

sentences.en: And if it is okay, what's the most appropriate and ethical way to go about doing that?
sentences.zh: 如果可以，最合适且合乎道德的方式是什么？

sentences.en: You know, early on I might have answered this question differently, but now we have so many vaccines, so much of it, and so quickly that I think anybody who
sentences.zh: 你知道，早些时候我可能会给出不同的回答，但现在我们有了这么多疫苗，数量充足，速度又快，所以我认为任何

sentences.en: really, really wants one and is willing to go to the extra effort of getting one should probably just get one.
sentences.zh: 真正非常想要接种并且愿意付出额外努力去接种的人，大概都应该去接种。

sentences.en: I mean, I wouldn't- That's interesting.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我不会——这很有趣。

sentences.en: I wouldn't recommend falsifying a condition, which I have heard of people doing.
sentences.zh: 我不会建议伪造身体状况，我听说有人这样做过。

sentences.en: But I think if people want to stand in line for hours or be a little creative with how they figure out their eligibility,
sentences.zh: 但我认为，如果人们愿意排队几个小时，或者在如何确定资格方面稍微动点脑筋，

sentences.en: I'm okay with that.
sentences.zh: 我是可以接受的。

sentences.en: And why is that?
sentences.zh: 为什么这么说？

sentences.en: Because I guess I have to say I didn't expect that answer.
sentences.zh: 因为我不得不说，我没想到会是这个答案。

sentences.en: Because at this point, Michael, we're really just trying to get to herd immunity.
sentences.zh: 因为在这一点上，迈克尔，我们真的只是在努力实现群体免疫。

sentences.en: We are trying to get as many people vaccinated as possible because we have to get those numbers down.
sentences.zh: 我们正试图让尽可能多的人接种疫苗，因为我们必须降低感染数字。

sentences.en: The infection rate is still way too high.
sentences.zh: 感染率仍然太高了。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So what you're saying is a dose and an adult arm is a good thing, period.
sentences.zh: 所以你的意思是，只要成年人接种了疫苗，就是一件好事，句号。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I do want to add one caveat, though, which is that on an individual level, I think that's absolutely fine.
sentences.zh: 不过，我想补充一点，那就是在个人层面上，我认为这绝对没问题。

sentences.en: But I think as a society, we do need to figure out how to get vaccines to communities that are hit the hardest and yet probably have the least time and resources to get
sentences.zh: 但我认为作为一个社会，我们确实需要想办法将疫苗送到受影响最严重，但可能最缺乏时间和资源去

sentences.en: themselves a vaccine.
sentences.zh: 接种疫苗的社区。

sentences.en: Very interesting.
sentences.zh: 非常有意思。

sentences.en: So that is adults and their timing for vaccines.
sentences.zh: 以上就是关于成年人及其疫苗接种时间的问题。

sentences.en: We talked to you a few weeks ago about children.
sentences.zh: 几周前我们和你谈过关于儿童的问题。

sentences.en: And during that conversation, you told us that the issue was that vaccine had not
sentences.zh: 在那次谈话中，你告诉我们问题在于疫苗还没有

sentences.en: been tested in children, which means they won't be eligible to be vaccinated until we know much more.
sentences.zh: 在儿童身上进行测试，这意味着在我们了解更多信息之前，他们没有资格接种疫苗。

sentences.en: And you said back then that your estimated timing for when children in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 你当时说，你预计美国儿童开始接种疫苗的时间是2022年冬季，这还有一段时间。

sentences.en: would start to be vaccinated was winter of 2022, which is a ways off.
sentences.zh: 情况有变吗？

sentences.en: Has that changed?
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我们明确一下我们所说的“儿童”是指什么。

sentences.en: Well, let's say what we mean by children.
sentences.zh: 如果我们指的是12到16岁或12到18岁的儿童，

sentences.en: If we mean children 12 to 16 or 12 to 18,
sentences.zh: 这些孩子将在秋季接种疫苗。

sentences.en: those children were going to be vaccinated in the fall.
sentences.zh: 这一点没有改变，因为目前正在进行的临床试验结果预计将在夏季某个时候出来。

sentences.en: That has not changed because those results from the clinical trials that are going on now will be expected sometime around the summer.
sentences.zh: 改变的是莫德纳宣布现在将开始在6个月及以上的儿童身上测试疫苗。

sentences.en: What has changed is that Moderna announced that it would now start testing the vaccine in kids six months and up.
sentences.zh: 这完全是新的进展。

sentences.en: And that's completely new.
sentences.zh: 这确实有点令人惊讶，因为人们原本认为所有公司都会先观察疫苗在年龄较大儿童身上的效果，然后再转向年龄较小的儿童。

sentences.en: And it was kind of a surprise, really, because the thinking was that all the companies would wait to see how the vaccine did in older children before moving to younger children.
sentences.zh: 我不确定他们为什么改变了计划。

sentences.en: I'm not exactly sure why they changed their plan.
sentences.zh: 而且这不是莫德纳会随意透露的信息。

sentences.en: And this is not the kind of information Moderna will freely give out.
sentences.zh: 但总的来说这是个好消息，因为这意味着进展很快，我们可能会在今年年底前看到所有儿童都能接种疫苗。

sentences.en: But it's overall good news because it does mean that the process is moving quickly and we may see vaccines for all kids by the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 说到疫苗尚未经过广泛测试的人群，即孕妇和哺乳期妇女，我们对她们有什么以前不知道的了解吗？

sentences.en: Speaking of people who the vaccine has not been widely tested on, pregnant women and nursing mothers, what are we learning about them that we didn't know before?
sentences.zh: 疫苗一直被推荐给哺乳期妇女，但从未有过关于她们的安全担忧。

sentences.en: The vaccine was always recommended for women who are breastfeeding, but there was never any safety concern about them.
sentences.zh: 这一点没有改变。

sentences.en: And that has not changed.
sentences.zh: 对于孕妇，情况稍微复杂一些。

sentences.en: For pregnant women, it was a little bit more nuanced.
sentences.zh: 由于数据不多，疾控中心表示每位女性都应该咨询医生，

sentences.en: Because there was not a lot of data, the CDC said every woman should really talk to her doctor
sentences.zh: 权衡各自的风险和收益，看看是否适合自己。

sentences.en: and figure out if it makes sense for her to weigh the risks and benefits for each individual.
sentences.zh: 我们没有看到任何迹象表明疫苗对孕妇不安全。

sentences.en: We have not seen anything to indicate that the vaccines are unsafe for pregnant women.
sentences.zh: 如果有的话，我们现在有数以万计的孕妇接种了疫苗，我们还没有听说出过任何问题。

sentences.en: If anything, we now have tens of thousands of pregnant women who've been vaccinated and we haven't heard of anything going wrong.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为正如我们所怀疑的那样，疫苗对孕妇实际上相当安全，这种可能性很大。

sentences.en: So I think the chances are pretty good that as we suspected, the vaccine is actually quite safe for pregnant women.
sentences.zh: 最后，关于疫苗接种和供应的问题，我很好奇，随着越来越多的人

sentences.en: So finally on the subject of vaccinations and availability, I'm curious, as more and more
sentences.zh: 获得资格，我们对美国拒绝接种疫苗的人群有什么了解？

sentences.en: people are becoming eligible, what we're learning about who is refusing vaccines in the United States?
sentences.zh: 我们是否可以开始说哪一群美国人最抵触，或者说坚持得最久？

sentences.en: And if we can begin to say which group of Americans is holding out the most and I guess the longeSt.
sentences.zh: 我认为目前主流的说法是，是有色人种社区，是少数族裔

sentences.en: I think the dominant narrative out there is that it's communities of color, that it's the minority
sentences.zh: 群体，他们对政府有合理的怀疑，所以他们拒绝接种疫苗。

sentences.en: populations who very legitimately have mistrust of the government and that they are refusing the vaccine.
sentences.zh: 但事实上，这并不完全正确。

sentences.en: But in fact, that's not quite true.
sentences.zh: 目前表现出最大犹豫的群体是一群投票给共和党的男性。

sentences.en: The group that is showing the most hesitancy right now is a group of men who vote Republican.
sentences.zh: 保守派男性。

sentences.en: Conservative men.
sentences.zh: 投票给共和党的保守派男性中，约有一半人表示他们没有接种疫苗的计划。

sentences.en: Conservative men who vote Republican, about half of them have said they have no plans to get the vaccine.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常有意义的数字。

sentences.en: That's a very meaningful number.
sentences.zh: 这是一个巨大的数字。

sentences.en: It's a huge number.
sentences.zh: 我们该如何解释这一点？

sentences.en: And how do we explain that?
sentences.zh: 我们该如何解释这一点？

sentences.en: Well, when you think about the fact that even something as simple as masks became a political weapon, it's not entirely surprising.
sentences.zh: 嗯，考虑到连口罩这么简单的事情都变成了政治武器，这其实并不完全令人惊讶。

sentences.en: I think there have been a lot of political leaders on the
sentences.zh: 我认为有很多共和党阵营的

sentences.en: Republican side who have said things about the vaccine that are not true, have said things about the virus that are not true.
sentences.zh: 政治领导人对疫苗发表了不实的言论，对病毒也发表了不实的言论。

sentences.en: Former President Trump got vaccinated, but he did so not publicly, not with photographs the way that all the other former presidents did.
sentences.zh: 前总统特朗普接种了疫苗，但他没有公开接种，也没有像其他所有前总统那样留下照片。

sentences.en: All of those things give a message and they give a message that the vaccine is either something you don't want or you don't need.
sentences.zh: 所有这些行为都在传递一种信息，那就是疫苗要么是你不需要的，要么是你没必要打的。

sentences.en: And until that message changes, I don't think we have a hope of reaching those men.
sentences.zh: 除非这种信息有所改变，否则我认为我们没有希望争取到那些人。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Apoorva, with vaccinations expanding so rapidly, we want to talk to you about the latest understanding of life after the shot.
sentences.zh: 阿普尔瓦，随着疫苗接种范围迅速扩大，我们想和你聊聊目前对接种后生活的最新认识。

sentences.en: And I want to start with literally moments after the first shot, since a lot of Americans are about to get one of the vaccines that requires two shots.
sentences.zh: 我想从接种第一针后的那一刻谈起，因为很多美国人即将接种需要打两针的疫苗之一。

sentences.en: So what are the common side effects of an initial shot and how commonly and quickly do they appear?
sentences.zh: 那么，第一针常见的副作用有哪些？它们通常多快会出现？

sentences.en: So when you first get a vaccine, probably the only thing you will feel immediately is a little bit of soreness at the injection site.
sentences.zh: 当你刚接种疫苗时，你唯一会立即感觉到的可能就是注射部位有一点酸痛。

sentences.en: What happens after that has been hugely variable.
sentences.zh: 在那之后发生的情况差异很大。

sentences.en: For a lot of people, they feel perfectly fine, maybe a little bit of tiredness, but that's pretty much it.
sentences.zh: 对很多人来说，他们感觉完全正常，可能有一点疲倦，但基本也就这样了。

sentences.en: But some people react a little bit more.
sentences.zh: 但有些人反应会稍微大一点。

sentences.en: They may have headaches, they may have a little bit of a fever, they may have a body ache, they may need to lie in bed for a few hours.
sentences.zh: 他们可能会头痛、轻微发烧、身体酸痛，可能需要卧床休息几个小时。

sentences.en: It's extremely variable.
sentences.zh: 情况极其多变。

sentences.en: So by and large, mostly minor side effects and still pretty rare.
sentences.zh: 所以总的来说，副作用大多很轻微，而且仍然相当罕见。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So staying with the first shot, how meaningful is the immunity that comes with just the first shot?
sentences.zh: 那么继续谈第一针，仅接种第一针所获得的免疫力有多大意义？

sentences.en: It feels like nobody quite quantifies it.
sentences.zh: 感觉好像没人能准确量化它。

sentences.en: I mean, is it half the immunity or is it more than half the immunity?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，它是获得了一半的免疫力，还是超过一半？

sentences.en: As you said, nobody's really quantified it.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，确实没人能真正量化它。

sentences.en: So I don't want to give people any assurances about one shot of the Pfizer or Moderna, but it does look like even one dose does a pretty good job.
sentences.zh: 所以我不想给人们关于辉瑞或莫德纳疫苗第一针的任何保证，但看起来即使是一剂疫苗也能起到相当不错的作用。

sentences.en: And it looks like it's more than half, but protection is absolutely not complete after the first dose.
sentences.zh: 看起来保护力超过了一半，但第一剂之后保护绝对不完整。

sentences.en: So people should continue to take all precautions, wear a mask, maintain social distance, all of that until after they get their second dose.
sentences.zh: 所以人们应该继续采取一切预防措施，戴口罩、保持社交距离，直到接种第二剂之后。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So they should not act as if they've gotten halfway towards immunity.
sentences.zh: 所以他们不应该表现得好像已经获得了一半的免疫力一样。

sentences.en: They should, in some ways, act as if there's no immunity and they're still operating under all the normal rules.
sentences.zh: 在某些方面，他们应该表现得好像没有免疫力一样，继续遵守所有常规规则。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So on to the second shot.
sentences.zh: 那么谈谈第二针。

sentences.en: I want to start with symptoMs. Many people in my own life say that the second shot is the one that really ran them ragged.
sentences.zh: 我想先从症状说起。我身边很多人说，第二针才真正让他们感到精疲力竭。

sentences.en: And I don't want to rely on anecdotes, but my sense is that that is a somewhat widely held experience.
sentences.zh: 我不想依赖轶事，但我的感觉是这是一种比较普遍的经历。

sentences.en: I think that's true.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是事实。

sentences.en: And I think it makes sense.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为这说得通。

sentences.en: Your body has already been exposed to the protein from the virus.
sentences.zh: 你的身体已经接触过病毒的蛋白质了。

sentences.en: It already knows how to recognize and give a reaction.
sentences.zh: 它已经知道如何识别并做出反应。

sentences.en: And so the second dose really causes you to have a very strong reaction.
sentences.zh: 所以第二剂确实会让你产生非常强烈的反应。

sentences.en: It's really telling you that your first dose worked, in a way.
sentences.zh: 从某种程度上说，这其实是在告诉你，你的第一剂起作用了。

sentences.en: That's interesting.
sentences.zh: 真有意思。

sentences.en: So when you hear people say, ah, I really don't feel well after my second shot, that means the vaccine is working.
sentences.zh: 所以当你听到人们说，啊，我打完第二针后感觉真的很不舒服，那意味着疫苗正在起作用。

sentences.en: They're kind of right.
sentences.zh: 他们说得有点道理。

sentences.en: Yeah, you should congratulate them.
sentences.zh: 是的，你应该祝贺他们。

sentences.en: But just to be clear, if you have no reaction, that's not necessarily a sign you're missing out.
sentences.zh: 但要明确一点，如果你没有任何反应，那并不一定意味着你没得到保护。

sentences.en: Absolutely not.
sentences.zh: 绝对不是。

sentences.en: Because as I was saying earlier, the reaction can be very variable.
sentences.zh: 因为正如我刚才所说，反应差异很大。

sentences.en: It's not the same for everybody.
sentences.zh: 并不是每个人都一样。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So what is the guidance on how long after the second shot is required for real and robust immunity to take effect?
sentences.zh: 那么关于接种第二针后需要多久才能产生真正稳固的免疫力，有什么指导意见吗？

sentences.en: Two weeks for full protection, regardless of the vaccine.
sentences.zh: 无论哪种疫苗，都需要两周才能获得全面保护。

sentences.en: So two weeks.
sentences.zh: 所以是两周。

sentences.en: And from everything you and our colleagues have told us, we know that vaccinated people will be well protected from the worst forms of infection.
sentences.zh: 根据你和我们同事告诉我们的一切，我们知道接种疫苗的人将能很好地免受最严重感染形式的侵害。

sentences.en: But the open question remains,
sentences.zh: 但悬而未决的问题仍然是，

sentences.en: how readily a vaccinated person can transmit the virus and whether the vaccine diminishes that ability to transmit the virus.
sentences.zh: 接种疫苗的人传播病毒的容易程度，以及疫苗是否会减弱这种传播病毒的能力。

sentences.en: So what is the latest understanding of that?
sentences.zh: 那么对此最新的认识是什么？

sentences.en: We know a little bit more than we did a few weeks ago.
sentences.zh: 我们比几周前知道的多了一点。

sentences.en: But this is the sort of burning question that everybody wants to know the answer to because they want to know if they can stop wearing masks around unvaccinated people.
sentences.zh: 但这正是每个人都想知道答案的迫切问题，因为他们想知道在未接种疫苗的人周围是否可以停止戴口罩。

sentences.en: The problem is that we just didn't really measure that during the clinical trials.
sentences.zh: 问题在于我们在临床试验期间并没有真正测量过这一点。

sentences.en: So we're trying to get that information now.
sentences.zh: 所以我们现在正试图获取这些信息。

sentences.en: There are a lot of natural experiments going on in the sense that millions of people have been vaccinated and some of the countries that have
sentences.zh: 目前有很多自然实验正在进行，因为有数百万人已经接种了疫苗，而一些已经

sentences.en: vaccinated them are following people to see how many get infected.
sentences.zh: 为他们接种疫苗的国家正在跟踪这些人，看看有多少人被感染。

sentences.en: So hopefully we'll know soon.
sentences.zh: 所以希望我们很快就能知道。

sentences.en: And so far, at least, it's looking like most people who are vaccinated don't transmit the virus, that it's a very small chance.
sentences.zh: 至少到目前为止，看起来大多数接种过疫苗的人不会传播病毒，几率非常小。

sentences.en: Exactly how small is what we need to know.
sentences.zh: 到底有多小，正是我们需要知道的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So knowing that, let's turn to the rules of the road for the vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 了解了这些，让我们谈谈接种疫苗者的行为准则。

sentences.en: I know the United
sentences.zh: 我知道美国

sentences.en: States government, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, has just issued some pretty detailed guidance on this.
sentences.zh: 政府，即疾病控制与预防中心，刚刚就此发布了一些相当详细的指导意见。

sentences.en: Who can be with whom, under what circumstances.
sentences.zh: 谁可以和谁在一起，在什么情况下。

sentences.en: So I want to talk about that kind of one scenario at a time with you.
sentences.zh: 所以我想和你逐个场景地讨论一下。

sentences.en: Let's start with vaccinated people who want to spend time with fellow vaccinated friends and family.
sentences.zh: 让我们从想要和同样接种了疫苗的朋友及家人共度时光的接种者开始。

sentences.en: What are the rules for that?
sentences.zh: 这方面的规则是什么？

sentences.en: There are very few rules.
sentences.zh: 规则很少。

sentences.en: You can take your masks off.
sentences.zh: 你可以摘下口罩。

sentences.en: You can get together indoors.
sentences.zh: 你们可以在室内聚会。

sentences.en: You can spend time, as much time as you want together, without worrying about getting infected.
sentences.zh: 你们可以共度时光，想待多久就待多久，而不必担心被感染。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So vaccinated with vaccinated can be with each other maskless.
sentences.zh: 所以接种疫苗的人和接种疫苗的人在一起时可以不戴口罩。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Let's say you are vaccinated, but your children and your grandchildren are not.
sentences.zh: 假设你接种了疫苗，但你的孩子和孙辈没有。

sentences.en: Here I speak from experience.
sentences.zh: 这里我以亲身经历为例。

sentences.en: My parents now both vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 我的父母现在都接种了疫苗。

sentences.en: Can you visit relatives who are unvaccinated and under what circumstances?
sentences.zh: 你可以探望未接种疫苗的亲戚吗？在什么情况下可以？

sentences.en: The CDC has said that vaccinated people can spend time indoors with one unvaccinated household.
sentences.zh: 疾控中心表示，接种疫苗的人可以在室内与一个未接种疫苗的家庭共度时光。

sentences.en: So if that's your unvaccinated children and grandchildren, that is okay.
sentences.zh: 所以如果那是你未接种疫苗的孩子和孙辈，那是可以的。

sentences.en: Why one household?
sentences.zh: 为什么是一个家庭？

sentences.en: The more people you have, the more risk.
sentences.zh: 人数越多，风险越大。

sentences.en: But also when you have multiple households, you're now bringing in all different kinds of exposure.
sentences.zh: 而且当你涉及多个家庭时，你现在引入了各种不同的接触源。

sentences.en: It's like bringing in all the people that the people in that household interacted with into your home.
sentences.zh: 这就像把你家里人接触过的所有人也都带进了你的家。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Because it's never just one household.
sentences.zh: 因为这从来不仅仅是一个家庭。

sentences.en: It's every single person, a member of that second household has interacted with.
sentences.zh: 而是那个第二个家庭的每一个成员所接触过的每一个人。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And that can add up pretty faSt.
sentences.zh: 这加起来会非常快。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So another scenario.
sentences.zh: 那么另一个场景。

sentences.en: What if you are a vaccinated adult and you want to visit unvaccinated friends or family, but you want to do so by plane, which I know many, many people do want to do.
sentences.zh: 如果你是一个接种了疫苗的成年人，你想去探望未接种疫苗的朋友或家人，但你想乘飞机前往，我知道很多人都想这样做。

sentences.en: It's a little bit tricky because air travel does involve spending a lot of time indoors with a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 这有点棘手，因为航空旅行确实涉及在室内与很多人长时间待在一起。

sentences.en: The plane itself is pretty safe because airplanes have excellent ventilation systeMs. And
sentences.zh: 飞机本身相当安全，因为飞机有极好的通风系统。而且

sentences.en: there are a lot of studies now showing that it's really just the two or three people right next to the person who's infected, who's at risk.
sentences.zh: 现在有很多研究表明，真正有风险的其实只是感染者旁边的那两三个人。

sentences.en: So it should be fairly safe.
sentences.zh: 所以这应该相当安全。

sentences.en: But taxis, people you're standing really close to at the airport, bathrooms, all of those are a little bit different.
sentences.zh: 但出租车、你在机场站得非常近的人、洗手间，所有这些情况都略有不同。

sentences.en: And so I would urge any grandparent who's traveling or anybody who's traveling really who's vaccinated to keep their masks on throughout.
sentences.zh: 所以我强烈建议任何旅行的祖父母，或者任何旅行的接种过疫苗的人，全程佩戴口罩。

sentences.en: Got you.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: But you can travel by plane as a vaccinated person to visit unvaccinated people.
sentences.zh: 但作为接种过疫苗的人，你可以乘飞机去探望未接种疫苗的人。

sentences.en: Has the CDC said whether that's a good idea?
sentences.zh: 疾控中心有没有说这是否是个好主意？

sentences.en: The CDC doesn't set rules.
sentences.zh: 疾控中心不制定规则。

sentences.en: So they recommend that people minimize travel unless they really need to.
sentences.zh: 所以他们建议人们尽量减少旅行，除非真的有必要。

sentences.en: Air travel is back and higher than it's been at any other time during the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 航空旅行已经恢复，且比疫情期间的任何时候都要多。

sentences.en: So I think this is the CDC being very practical, recognizing that if you say, hey, grandparents, if you're vaccinated, you can go visit your grandkids.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这是疾控中心非常务实的表现，他们认识到，如果你对祖父母说，嘿，如果你接种了疫苗，你可以去探望你的孙辈。

sentences.en: You can't also then tell them, but no, you can't get on a plane to go see them.
sentences.zh: 你不能随后又告诉他们，但是不行，你不能坐飞机去见他们。

sentences.en: Just doesn't make sense.
sentences.zh: 这根本说不通。

sentences.en: Gotcha.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Another quite common scenario, you're vaccinated and you want to go out to eat indoors.
sentences.zh: 另一个很常见的场景，你接种了疫苗，想去室内餐厅吃饭。

sentences.en: You haven't done it in a really long time.
sentences.zh: 你已经很久没这么做了。

sentences.en: It feels safe.
sentences.zh: 感觉很安全。

sentences.en: Is it a good idea?
sentences.zh: 这是个好主意吗？

sentences.en: The problem with restaurants, especially if they're crowded, is you don't know how many other people in there are unvaccinated.
sentences.zh: 餐馆的问题在于，特别是如果人多拥挤，你不知道里面有多少其他人没有接种疫苗。

sentences.en: And unless the restaurant has fantastic ventilation systems that are going to keep everybody safe, you may get infected from a fellow diner, then bring it home to other people.
sentences.zh: 除非餐馆有出色的通风系统来保证每个人的安全，否则你可能会从同桌食客那里感染，然后带回家传染给其他人。

sentences.en: We are hoping that the chances of that happening are very low, but we don't know that yet.
sentences.zh: 我们希望这种情况发生的几率非常低，但我们还不知道。

sentences.en: So I know that there are a lot of states, pretty much every state that has lifted restrictions on indoor dining, but I don't think we're quite
sentences.zh: 所以我知道有很多州，几乎每个州都取消了室内用餐的限制，但我认为我们还没有

sentences.en: where we need to be for people to freely dine indoors without worry.
sentences.zh: 达到人们可以无忧无虑地在室内自由用餐的程度。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有意思。

sentences.en: So in a way,
sentences.zh: 所以从某种程度上说，

sentences.en: planes better ventilated appear to be potentially safer than restaurants if they aren't all that well ventilated.
sentences.zh: 通风更好的飞机似乎比通风不好的餐馆可能更安全。

sentences.en: Ventilation, it turns out, for an indoor space is pretty much the most important thing.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，对于室内空间来说，通风几乎是最重要的事情。

sentences.en: So an open window might do the trick if there's a nice breeze and the window is big enough, and it will certainly help.
sentences.zh: 所以如果微风习习且窗户足够大，开窗可能就管用，而且肯定会有帮助。

sentences.en: But if we had, you know, the kind of health grades that we post on restaurants and there was a system to certify which restaurant has which kind of ventilation,
sentences.zh: 但如果我们有那种张贴在餐馆里的健康等级，并且有一套系统来认证哪家餐馆拥有什么样的通风设施，

sentences.en: maybe that would work, but we're not there.
sentences.zh: 也许那会奏效，但我们还没做到那一步。

sentences.en: But for the restaurant owners and restaurant workers listening to this, I do want to say, get takeout.
sentences.zh: 但对于正在听节目的餐馆老板和员工，我想说，做外卖吧。

sentences.en: We should still support those restaurants.
sentences.zh: 我们仍然应该支持那些餐馆。

sentences.en: There are other ways to do it.
sentences.zh: 还有其他方式可以做到。

sentences.en: Eat outdoors or get takeout, but just don't sit inside.
sentences.zh: 在户外用餐或买外卖，但就是不要坐在室内。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And finally, the office, the workplace, very near and dear to both of us.
sentences.zh: 最后，办公室，工作场所，这对我们俩来说都非常熟悉。

sentences.en: We work in the same office where we used to.
sentences.zh: 我们在同一个办公室工作，或者说曾经在同一个办公室工作。

sentences.en: Should vaccinated people be returning to the office?
sentences.zh: 接种过疫苗的人应该回到办公室吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I'm sorry that I'm going to repeat myself here, but ventilation.
sentences.zh: 很抱歉我要在这里重复一遍，但还是通风。

sentences.en: Ventilation, ventilation, ventilation.
sentences.zh: 通风，通风，还是通风。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And masks, masks, masks.
sentences.zh: 还有口罩，口罩，口罩。

sentences.en: So workplace return will be predicated on the speed of vaccinations.
sentences.zh: 所以重返工作场所将取决于疫苗接种的速度。

sentences.en: Everybody has their vaccinations, and obviously we can all go back to work.
sentences.zh: 每个人都接种了疫苗，显然我们都可以回去工作。

sentences.en: But until then, you're saying
sentences.zh: 但在此之前，你的意思是

sentences.en: if an office is not proven to be very well ventilated, then perhaps people should not return.
sentences.zh: 如果办公室没有被证明通风良好，那么人们或许不应该回去。

sentences.en: I completely recognize that that's not necessarily an option for everybody, that there are a lot of people who do have to go to work, even if the office is not well ventilated.
sentences.zh: 我完全明白这并非人人都能做到的选择，确实有很多人即便在办公室通风条件不佳的情况下，也必须去上班。

sentences.en: And as I said, wearing masks goes a long way.
sentences.zh: 正如我所说，佩戴口罩能起到很大作用。

sentences.en: So if it's a poorly ventilated environment, but you have no choice but to go to work, I would just wear a mask and be extremely careful.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果环境通风不良，但你又不得不去上班，我建议一定要戴上口罩，并格外小心。

sentences.en: As we're talking now, it occurs to me that there are a lot of rules to try to follow right now.
sentences.zh: 我们谈话时我突然想到，现在有太多规则需要遵守了。

sentences.en: And I wonder if you think people are struggling to learn these rules, but also to actually abide by them.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你是否认为人们在努力学习这些规则的同时，也难以真正去遵守它们。

sentences.en: I think it's hard.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这很难。

sentences.en: First of all, the rules are confusing.
sentences.zh: 首先，这些规则令人困惑。

sentences.en: You know, there's all these distinctions.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这里面有各种各样的区别。

sentences.en: Are you getting together with one household?
sentences.zh: 你是要和一户人家聚会吗？

sentences.en: Are you getting together with more than one?
sentences.zh: 还是和多户人家聚会？

sentences.en: Is it ventilated?
sentences.zh: 环境通风吗？

sentences.en: Is it not?
sentences.zh: 还是不通风？

sentences.en: It's just too many things to keep straight.
sentences.zh: 需要记住的事情实在太多了。

sentences.en: But also, we've been in this pandemic for a year, and people are desperate to feel like life is somewhat back to normal.
sentences.zh: 而且，这场疫情已经持续了一年，人们渴望生活能恢复正常。

sentences.en: And if they've been vaccinated, if they have actually gone through those stages, it's really hard to hear, yes, but we still want you to take all these precautions.
sentences.zh: 如果他们已经接种了疫苗，如果他们确实经历了那些阶段，听到“是的，但我们仍然希望你采取所有这些预防措施”时，真的很难接受。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But that is what people are being told.
sentences.zh: 但这就是人们被告知的内容。

sentences.en: And that's what they unfortunately have to be told until we know a little bit more and until we have enough people in the country vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，在我们了解更多信息，且全国有足够多的人接种疫苗之前，他们只能被这样告知。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's liberation with conditions.
sentences.zh: 这是有条件的自由。

sentences.en: So, Aprova, finally, I asked this of Carl Zimmer, your colleague, my colleague last time he was on, and I will ask it of you.
sentences.zh: 那么，Aprova，最后，上次你的同事，也是我的同事Carl Zimmer来的时候我问过他这个问题，现在我也想问问你。

sentences.en: Have you been vaccinated?
sentences.zh: 你接种疫苗了吗？

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 是这样的。

sentences.en: I have not.
sentences.zh: 我还没有。

sentences.en: And I am desperate to be.
sentences.zh: 但我非常渴望接种。

sentences.en: You're a New Yorker.
sentences.zh: 你是纽约人。

sentences.en: You are probably weeks away.
sentences.zh: 你可能再过几周就能接种了。

sentences.en: I hope so.
sentences.zh: 希望如此。

sentences.en: I mean, I hope that I can get it sometime before May, if not May.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我希望能在五月之前，或者最晚五月能接种上。

sentences.en: And one of the first things I'm going to do is go visit my parents.
sentences.zh: 我做的第一件事就是去探望我的父母。

sentences.en: So, yes, I would love to be vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我很想接种疫苗。

sentences.en: Just one household, though?
sentences.zh: 不过只能是一户人家聚会吗？

sentences.en: Just one household.
sentences.zh: 只能是一户人家。

sentences.en: Thank you, Aprova.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，Aprova。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: Today, now, in the 21st century, there is a concerted nationwide effort to limit the right of American citizens to vote and to truly have a voice in their own government.
sentences.zh: 今天，在21世纪，全国上下正齐心协力限制美国公民的投票权，限制他们在政府中真正发出自己的声音。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, Senate Democrats began hearings on what's expected to be their next major legislative push, a sweeping plan to expand voting rights and reform federal elections.
sentences.zh: 周三，参议院民主党人开始就他们预计的下一个重大立法举措举行听证会，这是一项旨在扩大投票权和改革联邦选举的全面计划。

sentences.en: Instead of doing what you should be doing when you lose an election in a democracy, attempting
sentences.zh: 在民主制度下，当你输掉选举时，你应该做的是尝试

sentences.en: to win over those voters in the next election, Republicans instead are trying to disenfranchise those voters.
sentences.zh: 在下一次选举中争取那些选民，而共和党人却试图剥夺这些选民的权利。

sentences.en: Shame on them.
sentences.zh: 真为他们感到羞耻。

sentences.en: The legislation is a direct attempt by Democrats to confront a wave of Republican efforts at the state level to restrict access to voting.
sentences.zh: 这项立法是民主党人为了应对共和党在州一级限制投票权的浪潮而采取的直接行动。

sentences.en: The bill would enact new rules to make it easier to vote, introduce new campaign finance laws, and end partisan gerrymandering of congressional districts.
sentences.zh: 该法案将制定新规则以简化投票流程，引入新的竞选财务法，并结束国会选区划分中的党派操纵行为。

sentences.en: The bill has already passed in the democratically controlled House, but faces longer odds in the Senate.
sentences.zh: 该法案已在民主党控制的众议院获得通过，但在参议院面临更大的阻力。

sentences.en: This bill is the single most dangerous bill this committee has ever considered.
sentences.zh: 这是本委员会审议过的最危险的法案。

sentences.en: Where it's encountering strong opposition from Senate Republicans, like Senator Ted Cruz of Texas, who denounced the bill on Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 它在参议院遭到了共和党人的强烈反对，例如来自德克萨斯州的参议员Ted Cruz，他在周三谴责了该法案。

sentences.en: This bill is designed to corrupt the election process permanently, and it is a brazen and shameless power grab by Democrats.
sentences.zh: 这项法案旨在永久性地破坏选举程序，这是民主党人厚颜无耻的权力攫取。

sentences.en: Democrats would need 60 votes in a Senate to pass the bill, unless they seek to end the filibuster rule.
sentences.zh: 除非民主党人寻求废除冗长辩论规则，否则他们需要在参议院获得60票才能通过该法案。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Alexandra Lee Young and Luke Vanderpluk.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由Alexandra Lee Young和Luke Vanderpluk制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by
sentences.zh: 编辑是

sentences.en: M.J.
sentences.zh: M.J.

sentences.zh: Davis-Lynn和Lisa Chow，音频工程由Corey Shreppel负责。

sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.zh: 我是

sentences.en: Michael Bavaro.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·巴瓦罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》节目，我们将为您准备假期接待客人的相关内容。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 敬请收听，获取让客人宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they black out to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是不是睡到不省人事。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线环境？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏或食物禁忌吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 请在《纽约时报》应用程序或您喜欢的任何播客平台上收听《Wirecutter秀》。
